originalTitle: 3 Reasons to Avoid SKY and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
summary: Champion Homes has followed the market’s trajectory closely, rising in tandem with the S&P 500 over the past six months. The stock has climbed by 13.3% to $85.71 per share while the index has gained 16.9%.
content:
Champion Homes has followed the market's trajectory closely, rising in tandem with the S&P 500 over the past six months. The stock has climbed by 13.3% to $85.71 per share while the index has gained 16.9%.

Is now the time to buy Champion Homes, or should you be careful about including it in your portfolio? Get the full stock story straight from our expert analysts, it's free .

Why Is Champion Homes Not Exciting?

We're cautious about Champion Homes. Here are three reasons why there are better opportunities than SKY, plus one stock we'd rather own.

1. Weak Sales Volumes Indicate Waning Demand

Revenue growth can be broken down into changes in price and volume (the number of units sold). While both are important, volume is the lifeblood of a successful Home Builders company because there's a ceiling to what customers will pay.

Champion Homes's units sold came in at 7,089 in the latest quarter, and over the last two years, averaged 2.3% year-on-year growth. This performance was underwhelming and suggests it might have to lower prices or invest in product improvements to accelerate growth, factors that can hinder near-term profitability.

Operating margin is a key measure of profitability. Think of it as net income - the bottom line - excluding the impact of taxes and interest on debt, which are less connected to business fundamentals.

Analyzing the trend in its profitability, Champion Homes's operating margin decreased by 9.1 percentage points over the last five years. Many Home Builders companies also saw their margins fall (along with revenue, as mentioned above) because the cycle turned in the wrong direction. We hope Champion Homes can emerge from this a stronger company, as the silver lining of a downturn is that market share can be won and efficiencies found. Its operating margin for the trailing 12 months was 8.7%.

3. New Investments Fail to Bear Fruit as ROIC Declines

We like to invest in businesses with high returns, but the trend in a company's ROIC can also be an early indicator of future business quality.

Over the last few years, Champion Homes's ROIC has unfortunately decreased significantly. We like what management has done in the past, but its declining returns are perhaps a symptom of fewer profitable growth opportunities.

Champion Homes isn't a terrible business, but it isn't one of our picks. That said, the stock currently trades at 23.1× forward P/E (or $85.71 per share). Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, but our analysis shows the upside isn't great compared to the potential downside. We're fairly confident there are better investments elsewhere. We'd recommend looking at the Amazon and PayPal of Latin America .

Champion Homes 密切关注市场走势，在过去六个月中与标准普尔 500 指数同步上涨。该股上涨 13.3% 至每股 85.71 美元，而该指数上涨 16.9%。

现在是购买 Champion Homes 的好时机，还是应该谨慎地将其纳入您的投资组合？直接从我们的专家分析师那里获取完整的股票故事，它是免费的。

为什么冠军住宅不令人兴奋？

我们对 Champion Homes 持谨慎态度。以下是为什么有比 SKY 更好的机会的三个原因，以及我们宁愿持有的一只股票。

1. 销量疲软表明需求减弱

收入增长可以分解为价格和销量（售出单位数量）的变化。虽然两者都很重要，但数量是房屋建筑商成功的命脉，因为客户支付的费用是有上限的。

Champion Homes 最新季度的销量为 7,089 套，过去两年平均同比增长 2.3%。这一业绩令人印象深刻，表明它可能必须降低价格或投资于产品改进以加速增长，这些因素可能会阻碍近期盈利能力。

营业利润率是衡量盈​​利能力的一个关键指标。将其视为净收入（底线），排除税收和债务利息的影响，这些因素与企业基本面的联系较少。

分析其盈利能力趋势，Champion Homes的营业利润率在过去五年中下降了9.1个百分点。许多住宅建筑商的利润率也下降（如上所述，收入也下降），因为周期转向错误的方向。我们希望 Champion Homes 能够从此成为一家更强大的公司，因为经济低迷时期的一线希望是可以赢得市场份额并提高效率。过去 12 个月的营业利润率为 8.7%。

3. 随着投入资本回报率下降，新投资未能取得成果

我们喜欢投资高回报的企业，但公司ROIC的趋势也可以作为未来业务质量的早期指标。

不幸的是，在过去几年中，Champion Homes 的投资回报率大幅下降。我们喜欢管理层过去的做法，但其回报率下降可能是盈利增长机会减少的症状。

Champion Homes 并不是一家糟糕的企业，但它不是我们的选择之一。也就是说，该股目前的预期市盈率为 23.1 倍（即每股 85.71 美元）。情人眼里出西施，但我们的分析显示，与潜在的缺点相比，其优点并不大。我们相当有信心其他地方有更好的投资。我们建议您关注拉丁美洲的亚马逊和贝宝。

我们比冠军住宅更喜欢股票

当您在这里时：排名前九的跑赢市场的股票。最好的股票不会只跑赢市场一次。他们又这么做了。又来了。强劲的收入增长、不断增长的自由现金流、资本回报率让他们在竞争中遥遥领先。市场已经给这些企业带来了回报。
